workspace.writeFailureHint: After a timeout or disconnect, check the refreshed status/history before retrying: the operation may have completed.

filter.label: Filter by file status
filter.noMatches: No files match the selected statuses
filter.discardMatchedConfirm: This will permanently discard changes in the {{count}} filtered file(s). Continue?
discardConfirm: This will permanently discard all uncommitted changes. Continue?

diffLoadMore: Showing {{shown}} of {{total}} lines — scroll down to load more
diffBinary: Binary file — no line diff available
splitUnsupported: Chapter split is not available in this backend runtime.
attributionHasExternal: External/terminal changes were observed in history
attributionHistoryComplete: The requested recorded-event window is fully loaded; unrecorded changes may still exist.
attributionHistoryTruncated: Only part of this file's event history is loaded; earlier participants and warnings may be missing.
attributionCountsLowerBound: Counts are lower bounds; unknown identities are not counted as distinct additional participants.
attributionFlagsUnknown: The absence of external changes or deleted actors is unknown, not a verified negative.
attributionLegacyObserved: Legacy observation only — Write/Edit action names do not prove precise attribution.
attributionNotCurrentOwnership: Historical participants may no longer contribute to the current net diff. No line ownership or contribution percentage is inferred.
attributionRecordedEvidence: Recorded v2 effects are historical evidence, not current ownership.
attributionCurrentExplanation: Current labels match verified v2 after-bytes to the index or worktree at the displayed baseline. History remains separate; +/- is the net diff, not an actor's contribution.
attributionCurrentUnknown: Current attribution is unknown; historical participants are not substituted for it.
attributionContinuityUnknown: Matching bytes do not prove authorship continuity after external replacement or who staged the file.
attributionIndexMode: Index mode verification covers Git's executable bit only, not full filesystem permissions.
attributionCurrentReason.no_evidence: No matching actual effect was recorded.
attributionCurrentReason.history_incompl: The bounded evidence window is incomplete.
attributionCurrentReason.ambiguous_order: The observation order is ambiguous; no actor is selected.
attributionCurrentReason.legacy_or_exter: Recent external or unverified observations prevent selecting an actor.
attributionCurrentReason.state_mismatch: Current bytes or mode do not match the recorded after-state.
attributionCurrentReason.unverified_effe: A complete, settled and confirmed measured effect is unavailable.
attributionCurrentReason.missing_raw: Required raw evidence is missing or could not be verified.
attributionCurrentReason.scope_unknown: The source or workspace incarnation could not be verified.
attributionCurrentReason.stale: The baseline changed during this read; refresh to recheck.
attributionCurrentReason.unsupported: This backend or filesystem object is not supported by current evidence verification.
attributionCurrentReason.budget_exceeded: Fingerprint or evidence exceeded the bounded display budget.
attributionCurrentReason.cancelled: Verification was cancelled or reached its deadline.
attributionObservationOnly: Badges show the latest observed actor and historical participants, not current diff ownership. +/- counts show the current net diff. Baseline fingerprint/epoch verification is not yet available.
attributionImprecise: Recorded observations do not establish exclusive, measured ownership of changes
attributionWindowTruncated: Attribution not fully loaded — some changes or paths fall outside the query window. Historical participant lists and warning flags may be incomplete; a missing badge does not mean nobody changed the file.
